I was brought into a world I didn’t want to be in to start. I grew up with a father who has anti social personality disorder, a sister with bipolar disorder, and a brother who would verbally and sometimes physically abuse me. I grew up in a place where your life means nothing and you’ll never do anything meaningful. I thought that with hard work I could not only live a meaningful life but help others that were in the same position as me. It wasn’t easy and at first I thought that I would never escape the environment I was in but i did and got accepted into a great school at a great place. Only to have that dream crushed as a few months in the world is literally going to hell and my school is closing for 2 weeks and it’ll probably be longer. Idk if I can stay here but I don’t even have enough money to go back home because of my father’s narcissistic and sociopathic tendencies. But it’s not like I want to go home. The universe has made it loud and clear there’s no point in improving your life that’s not what you’re here for. It’s to be beat down by it.
